text: {"name":"phy_count_channel_entries","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Counts nested-list nodes for records with a non-null child list and a byte at offset 116 other than 0xff; returns zero if any outer record has a nonzero byte at offset 106.","subsystem":"phy","var_renames":{"v0":"outer_entry","v2":"nested_entry"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"Next pointer for an outer or nested linked-list node"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"Nonzero value causes the function to return zero"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"Enables traversal of this record's nested list when nonzero"},{"offset":116,"meaning":"0xff sentinel; otherwise each nested node is counted"},{"offset":240,"meaning":"Pointer to the nested linked-list head"}]}
